title: Reusable PMS framework
context: The project memory framework may be useful across future projects, including unrelated domains.
problem: Avoid coupling reusable operating rules to one product or repository.
options_considered: Separate reusable framework from project-specific records.
Combine all instructions and project facts into one Lookaway-specific memory.
decision: Keep reusable PMS framework and project-specific memory logically separate; the framework remains project-agnostic.
rationale: Separation permits reuse and extraction without carrying one project's product assumptions into another.
consequences: Schemas, templates, and protocols use generic names and rules.
Lookaway decisions and architecture remain under its project memory.
